summary.name: ClipMenu
summary.one_liner: ClipMenu is a clipboard manager for Mac OS X that records clipboard history and lets you paste past items or saved snippets from a menu.
use_cases: Recall earlier copied text or images on a Mac
Store frequently used email addresses or user IDs for quick pasting
Paste past clipboard items via a keyboard shortcut menu
Keep a searchable-by-menu history of copied content
summary.what_it_does: ClipMenu records clipboard history and supports 8 clipboard types, from plain text to image. A user invokes a shortcut key to pop up a menu and selects a recorded item to paste it. It also lets users register frequently used texts as snippets, which can be pasted from the same menu. The page's listing on awesome-mac describes it as open source freeware.
notable: Records 8 clipboard types, from plain text to image
Shortcut key pops up a menu to choose items to paste
Snippets for frequently used text like email addresses
